metadata.description: The open retrieval layer for AI agents — index code, docs, PDFs, research, data. Pure-Python MCP server, cross-platform, zero pip required on user side.

plugins.name: rtfm
plugins.description: Indexes your project (code, docs, PDFs, legal, research) into a local SQLite FTS5 knowledge base. Serves surgical context to Claude via MCP. Auto-syncs on every prompt.
